text: あの…　ポケモン　コスプレ　しってます？
note: コスプレ is a Japanese-made abbreviation of "costume play"; the English word "cosplay" was borrowed back from it.
claim: The word cosplay comes from the Japanese コスプレ, an abbreviation of "costume play" coined in Japan in the 1980s.

check.quote: The term 'cosplay' is a Japanese blend word of the English terms costume and play. ... coined by Nobuyuki Takahashi of Studio Hard in an article for the Japanese magazine My Anime in June 1983.
check.note: コスプレ is a Japanese-made abbreviation of "costume play"; the English word "cosplay" was borrowed back from it.
